name: ez-skills
description: Ciprian's shared agent skills, edited only in this repository

plugins.name: ez-core
plugins.description: Core working skills: wdyr (researched recommendations), auto-run (work without stopping), ccf (group changed files into commits), check-code (DRY, SSOT and best-practice audit), check-code-full (check-code, then a bug review and a security review on the same scope), short-message (plain-text message to send), olcm (commit messages for the current changes), refine-prompt (handoff prompt for a fresh chat from rough notes), continue-prompt (handoff prompt that continues this session's work in a new session), fc (Figma cache with a category index), clarify-work (verified artifact page to clarify issues and pending items), cr (reads a request back and starts nothing until acr), sql-query (permission-checked MSSQL, MySQL and PostgreSQL queries, direct or over SSH), ssh-cmd (permission-checked commands on a named server over SSH), freshsales (Freshsales contacts: search, details and events; delete only as a command for the user); a commit-message rule and hook: messages come only from olcm or ccf
